environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (subnet-0a3f8e2c) within VPC vpc-04d91b7a. The subnet route table (rtb-0f82ca19) contains only a local route (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for S3, and no transit gateway attachment. The task uses an awsvpc network mode with security group sg-0e41f9b2d that permits inbound from the internal ALB only (sg-0cc7a1e3f on port 3000) and has NO egress rules (all outbound denied by explicit deny-all rule). The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with a single writable tmpfs mount at /app/tmp (size 512MB, noexec). The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0.

config.subnet_type: private, no NAT, no VPC endpoints
